Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: Exhaustive authorization decision union: authorized, denied, or escalated.

AuthorizedDecision.title: AuthorizedDecision
AuthorizedDecision.description: Authorization to execute, possibly under conditions and a validity deadline.

AuthorizationCondition.title: AuthorizationCondition
AuthorizationCondition.description: A condition attached to an authorization, optionally bound to a compiled constraint (W004).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

DeniedDecision.title: DeniedDecision
DeniedDecision.description: Denial with a machine-readable code and a required human-auditable reason.

DenialCode.title: DenialCode
DenialCode.description: Machine-readable denial code carried by denied authorization decisions.

EscalatedDecision.title: EscalatedDecision
EscalatedDecision.description: Escalation of the decision to another authorizer (gateway role or human approver).

AuthorizerReference.title: AuthorizerReference
AuthorizerReference.description: Who issued an authorization decision: the Action Gateway or a human approver. Agents are structurally excluded.

AuthorizerRole.title: AuthorizerRole
AuthorizerRole.description: Roles that may issue an authorization decision: action-gateway or human-approver. Agents are structurally excluded.
